questions.question: The Taj Mahal is located in which city?
questions.funFact: The Taj Mahal is made of white marble that seems to change colour at different times of the day.

questions.question: Which emperor built the Taj Mahal?
questions.funFact: Emperor Shah Jahan built the Taj Mahal in memory of his beloved wife, Mumtaz Mahal.

questions.question: The tall tower called the Qutub Minar is in which city?
questions.funFact: The Qutub Minar is the tallest brick tower in the world, at about 73 metres high.

questions.question: The Prime Minister raises the national flag at the Red Fort on Independence Day.
questions.funFact: Every 15 August, the Prime Minister hoists the flag and gives a speech from the Red Fort in Delhi.

questions.question: The Gateway of India stands beside the sea in the city of ___.
questions.funFact: The Gateway of India was built to welcome ships arriving in Mumbai from across the sea.

questions.question: Match each monument to the city where it is found.
questions.funFact: Many of India's grand monuments are hundreds of years old and are protected as national treasures.

questions.question: Which of these monuments is NOT in Delhi?
questions.funFact: The Charminar, with its four tall towers, is the pride of Hyderabad, not Delhi.

questions.question: The Statue of Unity, the world's tallest statue, honours which leader?
questions.funFact: Standing in Gujarat, the Statue of Unity is 182 metres tall, almost twice the height of the Statue of Liberty.

questions.question: The Taj Mahal is one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.
questions.funFact: In 2007, millions of people around the world voted the Taj Mahal one of the New Seven Wonders.

questions.question: The Sun Temple, shaped like a giant chariot, is at Konark in the state of ___.
questions.funFact: The Konark Sun Temple is built to look like the Sun God's chariot, with 24 carved stone wheels.

questions.question: The Hawa Mahal, or 'Palace of Winds', is in which city?
questions.funFact: The Hawa Mahal has 953 small windows that keep it cool by letting breezes blow through.

questions.question: The Charminar is a famous monument in Hyderabad.
questions.funFact: The name 'Charminar' means 'four towers', which is exactly what the monument has.
